questions.question: Anahat Singh is associated with which of the following sports events?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Squash**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Anahat Singh** is a young and talented squash player from India, known for her exceptional performance at the junior level.
 
• She gained prominence by winning the **U-11, U-13, and U-15 titles** at various international squash tournaments.
 
• Anahat represented India in the **Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games** at just 14 years of age, making her the youngest participant in squash at the event.
 
• She has achieved significant success, including a title at the prestigious **British Junior Open Squash** tournament.
 
• Anahat Singh is regarded as a rising star in Indian squash, showcasing immense potential to excel on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Squash:**

 
 
• Squash is a racquet sport played by two players (singles) or four players (doubles) in a four-walled court.
 
• The game involves hitting a small, hollow rubber ball against the walls of the court.
 
• It requires agility, precision, and tactical thinking, making it a physically demanding sport.
 
• Squash has been recognized by the **World Squash Federation (WSF)**, which governs international competitions.
 
 
 
• **British Junior Open Squash:**
 
 
• The British Junior Open is one of the most prestigious junior squash tournaments in the world.
 
• It attracts top junior players globally and serves as a platform for young talent to showcase their skills.
 
• Anahat Singh’s victory at this tournament highlights her skill and potential in squash.
 
 
 
• **Commonwealth Games:**
 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is a multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• Squash has been a part of the Commonwealth Games since 1998, offering a platform for global competition.
 
• Anahat Singh’s participation in the 2022 Games marked a milestone for Indian squash.
 
 
 
• **India's Rising Stars in Squash:**
 
 
• India has seen a growth in squash popularity due to players like **Dipika Pallikal**, **Saurav Ghosal**, and **Joshna Chinappa**.
 
• Anahat Singh is considered part of the next generation of Indian squash players aiming to achieve international acclaim.

questions.question: The name of the autobiography of Saina Nehwal is called:

options.text: Playing to win, my life on and off court

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Playing to win, my life on and off court**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Saina Nehwal** is an Indian professional badminton player and one of the most successful athletes in the sport.
 
• Her autobiography, **"Playing to win, my life on and off court"**, was published in the year **2012**.
 
• The book provides an in-depth look at her journey, experiences, and challenges in the badminton world.
 
• It highlights her achievements, including winning a **bronze medal at the 2012 London Olympics**.
 
• The autobiography is an inspiring account for aspiring athletes and sports enthusiasts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Career Highlights of Saina Nehwal**

 
 
• She has won over 24 international titles, including 11 Superseries titles.
 
• Saina has consistently been ranked among the top players in the world by the Badminton World Federation (BWF).
 
• She is the first Indian to win a medal in badminton at the Olympics.
 
• In 2015, she became the first Indian woman to achieve the world number 1 ranking.
 
 
 
• **Badminton as a Sport**
 
 
• Badminton is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• It is played as a singles or doubles game, and is popular worldwide, especially in Asia and Europe.
 
• The sport requires a high level of fitness, agility, and strategic thinking.
 
• Major tournaments include the Olympics, the All England Open, and the BWF World Championships.
 
 
 
• **Autobiographies of Prominent Athletes**
 
 
• Many athletes write autobiographies to share their journeys and inspire others. Examples include "Open" by Andre Agassi and "My Life in Football" by Kevin Keegan.
 
• These books often highlight the challenges faced, the determination needed, and the triumphs achieved in their careers.
 
• They serve as motivational literature for budding sports enthusiasts and the general public.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Sports Autobiographies**
 
 
• They provide personal insights into the lives of athletes beyond their public personas.
 
• Such books can inspire young athletes by showing the dedication and hard work required to succeed at the highest levels.
 
• They contribute to the cultural and historical documentation of sports and its impact on society.

questions.question: Who became the first woman to win two gold medals in a single Para Asian Games event in 2023?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sheetal Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sheetal Devi became the first woman to win two gold medals in a single Para Asian Games event in 2023.
 
• She achieved this historic feat in archery at the 4th Asian Para Games held in Hangzhou, China.
 
• Sheetal Devi won gold in both the individual W1 archery event and the mixed team W1 event.
 
• Her performance has been widely celebrated and recognized as a significant achievement in Indian para-sports.
 
• Sheetal's victories are a testament to her dedication and exceptional skill in archery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Para Asian Games:**

 
 
• The Para Asian Games are a multi-sport event held every four years for athletes with disabilities from all over Asia.
 
• The first Para Asian Games were held in 2010 in Guangzhou, China.
 
• The event includes a wide range of sports, similar to the Asian Games, but adapted for athletes with disabilities.
 
 
 
• **Archery in Para Sports:**
 
 
• Archery is a popular sport in para-sports, with events for athletes with physical disabilities.
 
• The categories in para-archery include recurve, compound, and W1 (wheelchair users with impairments in all four limbs).
 
 
 
• **India's Performance in Para Asian Games:**
 
 
• India has shown impressive performances in the Para Asian Games, securing numerous medals in various sports.
 
• The country has been improving its ranking and medal count with each edition of the games.
 
 
 
• **Support for Para Athletes in India:**
 
 
• The Indian government and various sports organizations provide support and training facilities for para-athletes.
 
• Initiatives like the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) offer financial assistance and training support to elite para-athletes.

questions.question: From which state in India did the legendary volleyball player Jimmy George hail?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jimmy George, hailed as one of India’s greatest volleyball players, was born in **Kerala**.
 
• He was born in **Mavelikkara, Alappuzha District**, Kerala on March 8, 1955.
 
• Jimmy George was the first Indian volleyball player to play professionally overseas, representing clubs in Italy.
 
• He was awarded the **Arjuna Award** in 1976 for his exceptional contributions to Indian volleyball.
 
• Jimmy George passed away in a tragic car accident in **Italy** in 1987, leaving behind a legacy as a pioneer in Indian volleyball.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Volleyball in India:**

 
 
• Volleyball is a popular sport in India, governed by the **Volleyball Federation of India (VFI)**.
 
• India has consistently performed well in volleyball tournaments in Asia, particularly in the **Asian Games**.
 
• The sport gained significant recognition due to players like Jimmy George.
 
 
 
• **Arjuna Award:**
 
 
• The **Arjuna Award** is one of India's highest sporting honors, established in 1961.
 
• It recognizes outstanding achievements in national sports and is awarded by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• Jimmy George received the award for his exceptional contributions to volleyball in India.
 
 
 
• **Professional Volleyball Career:**
 
 
• Jimmy George represented **India** in several international volleyball tournaments, including the Asian Games.
 
• He played professionally for **Italian clubs**, such as Coletto Club and Treviso, which marked a historic milestone for Indian volleyball.
 
 
 
• **Kerala's Contribution to Sports:**
 
 
• Kerala is renowned for producing exceptional athletes across various sports, including volleyball, athletics, and cricket.
 
• Other notable athletes from Kerala include **P.T. Usha** (track and field) and **Sreesanth** (cricket).
 
• Sports culture in Kerala is deeply rooted, with strong emphasis on nurturing talent at the grassroots level.

questions.question: Who was the first Indian woman to be inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Diana Edulji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Diana Edulji** became the first Indian woman to be inducted into the prestigious **ICC Hall of Fame**.
 
• She was a pioneering figure in Indian women's cricket and captained the Indian women's team during her career.
 
• Diana Edulji played for India from **1976 to 1993**, establishing herself as one of the most successful Indian cricketers of her time.
 
• She was widely known for her left-arm spin bowling and her immense contribution to popularizing women's cricket in India.
 
• Edulji has also been recognized with the **Padma Shri**, one of India's highest civilian honors, for her contribution to sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC Hall of Fame**

 
 
• The ICC Hall of Fame was launched in **2009** by the International Cricket Council to recognize the greatest cricket players in history.
 
• It honors players who have made significant contributions to the game of cricket at the international level.
 
• Inductees are selected by a special committee of cricket experts and historians.
 
• It includes players from all cricket-playing nations, highlighting their achievements and legacy in the sport.
 
 
 
• **Diana Edulji's Career Stats**
 
 
• Edulji played **20 Test matches** for India, taking 63 wickets at an average of 25.77.
 
• In **34 ODIs**, she took 46 wickets and was instrumental in many of India's victories.
 
• She was also known for her leadership, captaining India in multiple international matches.
 
 
 
• **Women's Cricket Milestones**
 
 
• India's women's cricket team played their first Test match in **1976**, with Diana Edulji as a key player.
 
• The team has since grown significantly, making notable achievements such as reaching the **finals of the ICC Women's World Cup** in 2005 and 2017.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian ICC Hall of Fame Inductees**
 
 
• Other Indian cricketers in the ICC Hall of Fame include **Sunil Gavaskar, Kapil Dev, Anil Kumble, Rahul Dravid, and Sachin Tendulkar**.
 
• These players have been recognized for their outstanding contributions to Indian and world cricket.
